headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | Python, React, Node.js
summary: Software Engineer with nearly 4 years of professional experience developing web applications and backend services for retail and financial clients. Holds a Licenciatura in Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores with a focus on software systems. Experienced in Python, PostgreSQL, and React within Agile Scrum teams.

experience.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed and maintained backend microservices in Python (FastAPI and Django) connected to PostgreSQL databases for an order-management platform.
Built customer-facing dashboard components using React and TypeScript, reducing page load times by 18%.
Configured automated testing and CI/CD deployment workflows using GitLab CI.
Participated in two-week Agile Scrum sprints, daily stand-ups, and peer code reviews.

experience.title: Junior Full-Stack Developer
bullets: Implemented RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express) and MongoDB for internal fleet-tracking web applications.
Developed responsive frontend interfaces in React and maintained legacy internal tools.
Assisted in setting up automated build pipelines in GitHub Actions across 4 repository projects.

education.degree: Licenciatura (bachelor's degree) in Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (Electrical and Computer Engineering)
education.institution: Faculdade de Ciências e Tecnologia da Universidade de Coimbra (FCTUC)

mandatory_evidence.evidence: Licenciatura (bachelor's degree) in Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (Electrical and Computer Engineering)
Software Engineer with nearly 4 years of professional experience developing web applications and backend services
Developed and maintained backend microservices in Python (FastAPI and Django) connected to PostgreSQL databases

borderline_note: Mandatory requirements 1 and 3 are both borderline: the degree is in Engenharia Eletrotécnica e de Computadores (a closely related degree rather than Computer Science or Engenharia Informática), and hands-on production experience with Python and PostgreSQL is at the 2-year mark (May 2024 to Apr 2026), as the earlier 2022-2024 role used Node.js and MongoDB.
